Accurate monthly books, payroll and year-end financial statements — prepared in line with Malaysian standards and ready for audit and LHDN.

  • Monthly bookkeeping & bank reconciliation

  • Audit-ready records

Bookkeeping that keeps you compliant all year

Most SME tax and audit problems start with books that are updated once a year, in a rush. We keep your records current every month, so your financial statements, audit and Form C are built on clean numbers — not reconstructed from a shoebox of receipts.

What we do each month

  • Record sales, purchases and expenses from your invoices, receipts and bank statements.
  • Reconcile your bank and payment accounts and follow up missing documents.
  • Prepare management accounts — profit and loss, balance sheet and simple cash-flow view.
  • Run payroll and file EPF, SOCSO and EIS contributions and monthly tax deductions (PCB).
  • Prepare and file SST returns if you are SST-registered.

Year-end financial statements

At year end we prepare financial statements in line with the applicable Malaysian financial reporting framework, ready to go to your auditor, your directors and SSM. Because the books were kept monthly, audit preparation is faster and less disruptive.

e-Invoice and digital readiness

Malaysia’s LHDN e-Invoice (MyInvois) requirement is being phased in by business turnover. We help SMEs check which phase applies, set up the right accounting software or portal workflow, and keep records in the format LHDN expects. Talk to us about where your business stands.

Why SMEs choose one team for accounts, audit and tax

When the firm keeping your books also coordinates your statutory audit and files your corporate tax, nothing falls between two providers and year end stops being a scramble.

FAQ

Accounting questions

How often do you update our books?

Monthly, as a minimum. You send documents through WhatsApp, email or shared folder and we reconcile and report each month.

Do you use accounting software like AutoCount, SQL or Xero?

We work with the common platforms used by Malaysian SMEs and can advise on which fits your size and industry. Ask us about your current setup.

Can you handle payroll, EPF and SOCSO?

Yes. We run payroll and prepare EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB submissions so your employer obligations are met on time.

Can I hire you for year-end accounts only?

Yes, though we recommend monthly bookkeeping — it is usually cheaper than cleaning up a full year of records at year end.
